name: Tibialis Raise
steps: Lean your back against a wall and walk your feet forward slightly, keeping them hip-width apart.
Shift your weight onto your heels with your arms resting relaxed at your sides.
Pull your toes and forefeet smoothly upward toward your shins as high as possible, squeezing the muscles along the fronts of your shins firmly.
Lower your forefeet slowly back down just short of touching the floor before lifting again.
tips: Walk your feet farther forward from the wall to increase difficulty or closer to the wall to make it easier.
Hold your knees steady so your forefeet rise from the ankles.
